headline: Developer Eagle Rock Partners plans a $6 billion data center campus in Jefferson Davis County, Mississippi, one of the poorest counties in the US.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: the meeting and first report date from 29-30 Sep 2026, and only a short excerpt could be read.
importance_line: Jefferson Davis County residents are affected first, as the project would be large against the county's means, but the excerpt gives no details on power, water, jobs or approvals.
summary: Mississippi Today reports, as carried by the Northeast Mississippi Daily Journal, that developer Eagle Rock Partners is planning a $6 billion data center called the Big Woods Technology Park in Jefferson Davis County and held an informational meeting on Tuesday 29 Sep 2026 to answer residents' concerns. Construction could begin as early as 2027, and the county is described as one of the poorest in the country.
notes: Planetizen and Mississippi Today blocked; the only text read is a short excerpt on the Daily Journal. 'Poorest' comes from the headlines.
